skill.name: Fix punctuation in a draft
skill.why: Broken punctuation makes readers stumble, even when the words are great.
skill.how: Read each sentence slowly. Check the ending, the capital, then apostrophes and commas.

beats.say: Editors hunt for broken punctuation in other people's drafts.
First, check how each sentence ends.
beats.show: Where is my soup**?** It was right here**.**

beats.say: Next, check each sentence starts with a capital.
Then check the little marks: apostrophes and commas.
beats.show: **Don't** eat my eggs**,** jam or toast.

beats.say: Only fix real mistakes. Don't add marks for fun.
